thesis.dol_rationale: london(cur)_low at D1 is the nearest unswept, undepleted draw on the DOWN side, 138 pts below current price (1.31x avg 1h range). The session-tier extremes (asia/london) are the active battlefield in NY-morning — both tickers tested but rejected going beyond their london-session highs, a coordinated rejection of upper structure that makes the lower session extreme a natural first target and exhaustion point.
thesis.falsified_if_rationale: A 1h close above london(cur)_high (F1 in the DOWN menu) would signal a failure of the rejection read — if price reclaims above the level MNQ just failed at, the bearish momentum is broken and a retest of higher structure becomes likely. F1 uses 1h (the timeframe of the rejection itself) for confirmation speed.
thesis.exhausted_if_rationale: london(cur)_low at X1 is the DOL itself — reaching the first support completes the downside thesis. The pool is fresh (swept only 199m ago on the lagger MNQ's side, not yet depleted), so a touch+beyond of this level (X1 in the DOWN menu) marks the move's natural conclusion and opens the question of whether price reverses or continues deeper.
